(5) A string that parses as a PEP 508 requirement without a URL is a package. This is checked after the path forms and before the separator test.
(6) New rows cover a backslash separator on every platform and an absolute path ending in .git.

nonblocking.title: The whitespace decision rests on a false premise: update now refuses a git record that aelix's own typed install writes
nonblocking.detail: Item 3's decision said catalogs and aelix's records never carry surrounding whitespace. They can. A typed `aelix extension install 'git+file:///<repo> '` succeeds on both 8f7d98aa and e55a9fc8, and both record the spec with its trailing space. On 8f7d98aa, `update` then upgraded it (rc 0, uv strips the space). On e55a9fc8, `update` exits 2 with 'begins or ends with whitespace ... Fix the catalog or the record', and the message gives no command to fix it. A record with a leading space was already broken on 8f7d98aa (argv 'git+ git+https...'). ADR-0255 section 16 lists this under known limits, so it was a known choice. It is still a regression for a record aelix writes itself. A simple fix: strip a typed git spec before recording it, or strip a git or pypi record before wrapping it as a CatalogSpec, so the checks and the install read the same string.
nonblocking.evidence: .omc/probes/405-live/r2verify/git-trailing-live.txt (real CLI, uv 0.11.19, offline): [before] install rc=0, RECORDS 'git+file:///tmp/405-work/r2verify/gitrepo ', update rc=0, GIT-REPO 5.0 installed; [after] install rc=0 with the same record, update rc=2 whitespace refusal. record-whitespace-after.txt: ' ssh://h.example/o/r.git' git record rc 2.

nonblocking.title: The CHANGELOG overstates the whitespace refusal for records
nonblocking.detail: The CHANGELOG says: 'A record or API source with leading whitespace (or, unless it is an absolute path record, trailing whitespace) is refused too'. Only CatalogSpec, git records and leading-space path records are refused.
